company.name: Valar Labs
company.shortDescription: Valar Labs offers assistance services for cancer treatment through Artificial Intelligence.
company.description: Valar Labs makes AI to interpret solid tumors and deliver insights, so physicians and patients can make informed treatment decisions.  Their AI algorithms analyze digitized pathology slides to assess spatial features, and they design transparent systems grounded in underlying biology so physicians can trust the results.

aiResearchSummary.text: Valar Labs is engaged in developing systems and methods for an artificial intelligence based pathology platform, as described in Predicting patient outcomes related to pancreatic cancer. This platform is designed to provide prognostic value to clinicians by predicting outcomes related to pancreatic cancer using histological samples. Their research and development focus on AI-driven tools to assist cancer treatment decisions and improve clinical prognostic capabilities.
